name: Insider Option – Instagram Congress Trade Story Poster

parameters.content:
## Instagram Stories variant

Same env vars as the feed workflow:

| Variable | Value |
|---|---|
| `INSIDER_OPTION_API_URL` | base URL of your backend |
| `IMAGE_GENERATOR_URL` | your image-gen Render service URL |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | from console.anthropic.com |
| `IG_USER_ID` | Instagram Business Account ID |
| `IG_ACCESS_TOKEN` | long-lived IG access token |

This workflow calls `/generate-story` (1080×1920) and posts
with `media_type: STORIES`. Stories have no caption.

Deduplication uses `lastStoryTradeId` in workflow static data,
independent of the feed workflow's `lastTradeId`.
